notes.theorem: Theorem 3 and the following additive-term discussion
notes.correction: The all-degree statement contains an additive palette term. It cannot be plotted as a fixed near-Δ palette in the bounded-degree main view. When Δ = 2^{O(√log n)}, runtime is O(log²n). This is the LOCAL theorem, not the slower CONGEST theorem. Full proof is the accepted DISC 2026 preprint, distinct from the published PODC brief announcement.
